rendered: In this paper, BA stands for 4-mercaptophenyl-boronic acid (4-MPBA, BA)[1]. This molecule is used to functionalize positively charged L-type intrinsically helical gold nanorods (L-HGNRs), which gives the BA@L-HGNRs recognition probes[2] that the paper uses to tell bacteria apart. The probes bind bacteria through electrostatic interactions together with boronic acid–cis-diol[3] dynamic covalent bonding.
